frame: MuJoCo world = rig frame: x toward the back wall (metric +Y), y to the robot's left (metric -X), z up; origin at the rail centre on the desk-top plane, desk top at z 0.90. Poses are parent_from_child with OpenCV camera axes; *_metric values are in the AHa-3D metric frame and mapped by world_from_metric

world_from_metric.source: /home/frank/robot/aha-3d/scenes/yam_bimanual_rig/metric/metric_frame.json (desk top z 0.72; rail recommended x centre -2.2647 = arm-base midpoint, y extent 1.314..1.434)

robot.model: i2rt YAM + linear_4310 gripper (stock claws), two followers

yam_white.source: fitted on the 12 09-22 calibration captures: grey p50/p90 114/195, real 114/188. The emission stands in for the room's bounce light on vertical faces.

dynamics.source: copied from rigs/raiden_lab/rig.json robot.dynamics (single-arm fit, 09-25, D435 wrist mass): not fitted on the bimanual arms. Known gaps: ZED X One + bracket mass, gravity factor 1.3 (raiden default for both followers). friction_solref/solimp: stiff joint friction, so the arm holds against the 1.3 feed-forward like the real arms (09-30, bimanual_bringup/dynamics)

home_joint_offsets.as: MuJoCo joint ref = -offset: q = 0 (raiden home, encoder zero) shows the fitted pose; joint ranges unchanged; the controller's gravity model still sees q
home_joint_offsets.note: zero-offset hypothesis: at one pose a zero offset and sag look the same
